title: Sea Baby III Fishing Charters Kona Hawaii

services.name: Private Fishing Charters
services.desc: Adventure out to sea with us for a fun day of fishing on the legendary Sea Baby III. The boat has a proven history of being a top producer when it comes to Big Game Fishing. The Sea Baby III is a 35’ custom Funai Sportfisher and was specifically built to catch monster fish! The boat is comfortable, clean, fast and very maneuverable. Captains and Crews worldwide agree that the Sea Baby III is the perfect Game Boat. Our catch includes Blue Marlin, Striped Marlin, Ahi, Ono, Mahi Mahi, Shortnose Spearfish, Yellowfin Tuna and Skipjack Tuna. The boat’s largest fish caught is a 1,195 pound Blue Marlin!
